title: Market Tracking
intro: There are more trading and markets bots in the public catalogues than you might expect, ranging from earnings-calendar watchers to templates that will happily tell you whether to buy. They are worth separating carefully. Monitoring is a real job a bot does well: watching a watchlist, flagging earnings dates, summarising a filing, noticing an unusual move and saying so. Advice is a different thing, and several listings here will produce a confident recommendation from a public price feed and a prompt, which is worth exactly what it costs. Nothing on this site executes a trade, and templates that claim to place orders should be treated with more suspicion than interest. Read what a bot is actually connected to. A markets bot with no data subscription is summarising the same free sources you could read yourself, more fluently and no more reliably.
